section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: Sex: During 1976, 58.1 percent of the total suicides were committed by males. A similar pattern was noticed in the 'Male' and 'Female' ratio during the year 1975. The 'male' and 'female' ratio in suicides for States was also the same as for the country as a whole. The percentage of male involvement in 13 States and 7 Union Territories was higher than the all-India average. For other States, there were variations in male & female ratio in comparison to the all-India average. The details are presented in Table 7.
